topology: Battery cell removed; original battery strip connected to Monsoon set to 3.90 V; PC USB also connected. Wiring and current-sense boundaries not electrically verified.
method: 32 sequential sysfs reads per phase, nominal 250 ms sleep plus read overhead; one bounded QNN CPU Conv/ReLU workload with duration 8 seconds, 2329 inferences. Not a calibrated benchmark; idle includes measurement overhead.

battery_units.capacity: reported percent, not meaningful physical remaining cell charge with cell removed
battery_units.power_now: Samsung driver exposes ISYS in milliamps; not watts or microwatts
battery_units.power_avg: Samsung driver exposes averaged ISYS in milliamps; lagging

perfetto.limitation: Scheduler events wrapped the main trace ring buffer; initial phase markers absent. Do not use it as a complete scheduler capture.
perfetto.derived_power: batt.power_mw is abs(current_ua * voltage_uv) / 1e9, calculated by trace processor; it is not an independent meter.
perfetto.powerstats_hal: No registered AIDL or HIDL PowerStats HAL found; framework powerstats service exists but its dump was empty. Power/Health HALs are different services.
